note: NIH's UL covers preformed vitamin A only; no UL is set for beta-carotene. USPSTF recommends against beta-carotene supplements for preventing heart disease or cancer.
The label does not split niacin and niacinamide. NIH's supplemental UL applies to both forms.
The UL is set for folic acid; whether it applies to 5-MTHF is not established.
NIH has set no UL for B12.
FDA advises telling your clinician about any biotin you take before lab tests.
Ask your clinician first if you take blood thinners.
